result.stdout:
Trykatch application and module toolkit

Create an application:
  trykatch template install
  trykatch update                 Update the template to this CLI's version.
  trykatch template uninstall    Remove the installed project template.
  trykatch new <name> [options]  Create an application and initialize Git.
  trykatch start                  Start a generated application through Aspire.

Application options:
  --ui <react|none>  Include the React frontend or generate a backend-only application.
  --email            Include SMTP email and local Mailpit support.
  --storage          Include local and S3-compatible object storage.
  --documents        Include spreadsheet and PDF exporters.
  --images           Include image validation and processing.

Module lifecycle:
  trykatch module help     Show every module command and option.
  trykatch module list     List installed modules and their state.
  trykatch module doctor   Validate the full-stack module graph.

Run 'trykatch new --help' for application-generation options.
